about: The lead's rulings on the Phase 1 extraction (docs/contract/extraction/*.json). Read by scripts/build-contract-docs.mjs. conflicts: keyed by the B-number of a frontend-versus-map conflict (numbered in extraction order); anything not listed is 'Proposal accepted'. answers: keyed '<feature> Q<n>'. extra: backend entries not tied to one endpoint. openQuestions: business rules waiting for the user (the lead default applies until answered).

11.decision: GET /health always answers 200 JSON {status: ok|degraded|down, checks} for the console; GET /health?strict=1 answers 503 when a dependency is down, for load balancers (same route, so route parity holds). Decision 015.

14.decision: Accept the optional dispatch: true (change + enqueue in one transaction); the two-call flow keeps working.

16.decision: Reject on a B2C order not yet delivered runs the full refund path in the same transaction (system-approved refunds row, b2c_refund, gateway refund job). Reject on a B2C order delivered before (reopened) answers 409 USE_REFUNDS (orders Q8). Decision 025.

17.decision: Reopen reverses revenue only; cogs stays (decision 024). A later completion books cogs again only for a new supplier charge.

25.decision: The sync runs in the worker (supplier-sync queue); the API waits for the job up to timeout_ms + 5 s (QueueEvents) and answers its counts, or 504 SUPPLIER_TIMEOUT while the job keeps running.

35.decision: Per-kind rows; add the owner_capital equity account for opening entries (decision 024).

38.decision: Lead default: debit bank when payment_gateways.is_manual, gateway_clearing otherwise. Confirm (OPEN-QUESTIONS 4).

41.decision: Lead default: a manual invoice is a top-up invoice: paying it posts the deposit event and emits invoice.paid; no VAT on B2B invoices; due_at = issue + 14 days (setting). Confirm (OPEN-QUESTIONS 3).

57.decision: POST /admin/content-pages/generate requires storefront:create (frontend M186); PUT /admin/risk/rules keeps the literal risk:*.

82.decision: Lead default until the user decides (OPEN-QUESTIONS 7): the refunds row keeps the internal status processing; the wire reports completed once approved (the reversal is posted at approval) and failed when the gateway refund fails. Preferred long-term: the console adds processing.

auth Q1.answer: Settings with defaults: staff sessions 8 h absolute, 30 min idle (last_seen_at throttled to 1/min), pre-2FA stage 10 min (decision 018).

access Q2.answer: No ROLE_PROTECTED code. One general guard instead: any change (role edit, staff role change, suspension) that would leave no active staff member holding '*' answers 409 LAST_OWNER. The Owner role can be renamed; it cannot lose '*' while it is the only source of Owners.

access Q7.answer: Yes: any action on an account whose role holds '*' requires the caller to hold '*' (403 FORBIDDEN naming '*'); closes the takeover path through a temporary password plus a 2FA reset.

audit Q8.answer: No export route: the map has none (route parity). Revisit if the map adds one.

customers Q12.answer: Refuse with 409 ERASURE_NOT_DONE until the customer is anonymized; export requests can be completed by hand.

checkouts Q3.answer: canRecover = consent AND no recovery email yet AND not paid AND older than abandonedMinutes; recovery stops 30 days after the checkout (setting); the email link starts a fresh checkout at today's price.

merchants Q7.answer: Lead default: earn_threshold is USD; promotion only, by a nightly job, on cumulative completed-order spend; merchantCount is sent; b2c_retail is editable, never deletable or assignable; ordinary groups have kind b2b. Confirm (OPEN-QUESTIONS 1).

merchants Q13.answer: Lead default: lowering below the credit in use is allowed (new orders are refused until a top-up); a limit above zero on a group without overdraft_allowed is 422 on creditLimit. Confirm (OPEN-QUESTIONS 2).

finance Q6.answer: Lead default: kind topup|manual|receipt|statement, status open|paid|void, invoices.description added; a paid manual invoice credits the wallet (deposit + invoice.paid); no VAT on B2B; due in 14 days (setting). Confirm (OPEN-QUESTIONS 3).

finance Q8.answer: Lead default: debit bank for is_manual gateways, gateway_clearing otherwise (later cleared by payout). Confirm (OPEN-QUESTIONS 4).

commissions Q8.answer: Lead default: before approval the accrual becomes reversed (approve skips it); after approval a reversing commission entry is posted on the agent wallet. Confirm (OPEN-QUESTIONS 5).

settings Q9.answer: Lead default: hold_hours = hours a confirmed payment through this gateway waits for manual review before the wallet is credited (0 = credit when confirmed); nothing is credited or cancelled automatically when it passes, the dashboard flags it. Confirm (OPEN-QUESTIONS 6).

refunds Q9.answer: Lead default: report a queued gateway refund as completed and switch to failed on refund.failed, until the console adds processing (preferred). Confirm (OPEN-QUESTIONS 7).

orders Q8.answer: No: rejecting a B2C order delivered before answers 409 USE_REFUNDS; post-delivery refunds always go through /admin/refunds (refunds:approve).

services Q6.answer: Lead default: follow the demo's resolver exactly (client price, group price, base price with the category rule, group discount, then the floor = cost + min profit); kinds margin|discount|promo, unsigned percent/fixed, rounding none|nearest_0.05|nearest_0.10|ends_99, nullable starts_at/ends_at, most specific scope wins, lowest priority within a scope. Confirm (OPEN-QUESTIONS 8).

suppliers Q7.answer: Suggested price = cost x (1 + the global margin rule), never under the floor; without a global rule the setting catalog.importDefaultMarkupPercent applies (default 60). Supplier custom fields become service_fields with supplier_key.

system-health Q2.answer: Adopt as defaults in a threshold config (code constants overridable by the settings key health.thresholds); final SLO targets stay an ops call.

extra.conflict: Map route rows list the main tables only; most admin rows also read joined data owned by other modules (group, wallet, stats, requester, assignee, payments, consents...).
extra.decision: The table list is the primary tables. Reads of another module's data go through that module's public query service (decision 016); no module reads another's tables directly.

extra.conflict: The frontend needs a pre-2FA session (login → 2fa/setup/password) but sessions has no field for the sign-in step.
Map: poll every minute in the first hour, then every 5 minutes, then every 30; it does not say when the 30-minute phase starts.
The mission asks for idempotency on Dhru order placement, but Dhru v6.1 has no idempotency field.
extra.decision: Dhru relies on the map's duplicate rule (orders.fingerprint while an order is open); REST v1 uses Idempotency-Key (decision 026).

extra.conflict: The map lists the optional file actions; the v6.1 standard server does not define their parameters.
extra.decision: Fixed from a second public implementation when stage 7 is built; same envelope (decision 026).

extra.conflict: ledger_accounts allows customer owners; the money events use one customer_funds account.
extra.decision: customer_funds is one system account; B2C traceability is per order through ref_type/ref_id (decision 024).

extra.conflict: B2C prices are in the customer's currency; the map's money events are in USD.
extra.decision: The ledger is kept in the base currency; a foreign-currency payment is posted at the rate locked in its checkout session; the payment row keeps the original amount (decision 011).

extra.conflict: Map scenario b2c-ticket: new > open > pending_customer > resolved > closed. The console renders new | open | pending | resolved and breaks on any other word.
extra.decision: Wire values follow the console: pending_customer is sent as pending; CSAT after resolution keeps resolved and only sets csat_score; closed is not used.

extra.conflict: The map protects 'the last owner' without defining an Owner; the console treats a role named Owner or containing '*' as Owner.
extra.decision: An Owner is a staff member whose role contains '*'. LAST_OWNER guards role edits, role changes and suspensions; actions on an Owner account need '*' (decision 018).

extra.conflict: Map: 'read from the monitoring system', which the stack did not include.
extra.decision: Add a Prometheus server (compose + PROMETHEUS_URL); 503 MONITORING_UNAVAILABLE when it is missing (decision 015).

extra.conflict: Decision 011 sends exact decimals as strings; the System health and dashboard measures are typed as JSON numbers by the console.
extra.decision: Follow the frontend type per field: numbers for measures and percentages there, strings for money and pricing/tax/FX rates (decision 011).

extra.conflict: The frontend needs fields the map's tables do not have.
extra.decision: Schema additions (each tied to its conflict entry): sessions.stage; audit_logs.entity_label; services.code, sla_minutes, min_profit, cost_was; pricing_rules.starts_at, ends_at; inventory_codes.code_hash, code_last4; clients.suspended_at, suspended_reason, suspended_by; payments.reviewed_at, review_note; invoices.description; refunds.note; data_requests.note; notifications.error; webhook_deliveries.response_body, error; alert_rules.deleted_at. New values: ledger ref_type set, order_events actor types system and supplier, orders.source set, suppliers.status paused, owner_capital account.

openQuestions.question: Which spend counts for promotion into a group, and is promotion automatic?
openQuestions.default: Cumulative completed-order spend in USD; a nightly job promotes (never demotes).

openQuestions.question: May a credit limit be lowered below the credit already in use, and may a group without overdraft_allowed have a limit?
openQuestions.default: Lowering is allowed (new orders refused until a top-up); a limit above zero on such a group is refused (422).

openQuestions.question: What does paying a manual invoice do, and does it carry VAT?
openQuestions.default: It is a top-up: paying it credits the wallet (deposit + invoice.paid); no VAT on B2B; due in 14 days.

openQuestions.question: When staff approve a bank/Wise transfer, which account is debited?
openQuestions.default: bank for manual gateways; gateway_clearing for automatic gateways (moved to bank by payout).

openQuestions.question: What happens to a referral commission when its order is refunded or reopened?
openQuestions.default: Before approval it is reversed (not paid); after approval a reversing entry takes it back from the agent's wallet.

openQuestions.question: What does a gateway's hold_hours mean?
openQuestions.default: Hours a confirmed payment waits for manual review before the wallet is credited; nothing happens automatically when it passes, the dashboard flags it.

openQuestions.question: The map has a refund status processing that the console does not know. Change the console, or report it as completed?
openQuestions.default: Report completed once approved, failed if the gateway refund fails, until the console adds processing (preferred).

openQuestions.question: How do client prices, group prices, category/global rules, group discounts, rounding and the floor combine?
openQuestions.default: Exactly the demo's resolver: client price, else group price, else base with the category rule, then group discount, then rounding, never under the floor (cost + min profit).
